code.pseudocode: The objective is a bowl with its lowest point at w = 3.
Start at an initial guess and evaluate its loss.
The gradient is the slope of the loss at the current point.
The downhill direction is the negative of the gradient.
Evaluate the loss and the gradient at the new point.

steps.label: We are at a new point

code.pseudocode: Repeat: compute the gradient, then update.
After many steps the weight is close to the minimum.
Training loop: compute the loss, compute the gradient, update, repeat.
